1. Engagement Scope

ACPWB conducted a targeted compliance review of Lockwood Ferris LLP's executive compensation programs, focusing on adherence to New York Labor Law §195 (wage notice requirements); Gramm-Leach-Bliley Act (GLBA) Safeguards Rule; SEC Regulation S-K Item 402 (executive compensation disclosure). The review covered all compensation actions for the top 248 executives for the fiscal year ending 2012-06-16.

2. Methodology

The assessment of Lockwood Ferris LLP's compliance with pay transparency laws included a programmatic scan of 248 of the company's career pages and third-party job boards to verify the presence and accuracy of salary range disclosures.

4. Detailed Findings
PMR-9810-001MEDIUMOPEN
Observation

Leave administration records incomplete or contradictory for FMLA-qualifying events

Corrective Action Required

A third-party specialist will be engaged annually to provide §280G "golden parachute" calculations for all named executive officers in connection with any potential change-in-control scenario.

Management Response

Management has reviewed the finding and determined that the current practice, while inconsistent with the recommendation, is based on a reasonable interpretation of an ambiguous regulation. We will continue to monitor regulatory developments but plan no immediate changes.

Owner: Vice President of Diversity, Equity & Inclusion • Due: 2012-08-28
PMR-1126-002INFORMATIONALDEFERRED
Observation

Incentive compensation recoupment policy not applied consistently across business units

Corrective Action Required

Immediately suspend the use of the identified automated employment decision tool in New York City pending the completion of a compliant bias audit and public disclosure of the results.

Management Response

Management has reviewed the finding and concurs with the recommended corrective action. The action has been entered into our GRC system, and automated reminders have been assigned to the owner.

Owner: Senior Director of Research & Analytics • Due: 2012-07-28
PMR-4058-003LOWOPEN
Observation

Stock option grant approval dates do not align with board meeting minutes for 248 awards

Corrective Action Required

The Tax department shall perform a look-back analysis to identify all non-deductible compensation under §162(m) for the past three fiscal years and file amended returns if necessary.

Management Response

The condition identified has been partially remediated. Lockwood Ferris LLP has addressed the majority of the affected population and is on track for full closure by the due date. A status update will be provided at the next scheduled review.

Owner: Compliance Specialist • Due: 2012-09-28
PMR-9781-004LOWMONITORING
Observation

Illinois Biometric Information Privacy Act (BIPA) written consent not obtained from 248 employees prior to collection of fingerprints for timekeeping

Corrective Action Required

A standardized process will be implemented to respond to all formal union information requests within 10 business days, with all responses reviewed by labor relations counsel.

Management Response

The finding is acknowledged. The issue affects a business unit that is being divested. The corrective action will be the responsibility of the new owner post-transaction close, which is anticipated on or before 2012-06-16.

Owner: Senior Manager of Operations • Due: 2012-10-28
PMR-4582-005LOWIN PROGRESS
Observation

Offer letter language inconsistent with executed employment agreements for 248 hires

Corrective Action Required

The retirement plan committee will adopt a formal investment policy statement (IPS) and document its review of plan investment performance against the IPS on a quarterly basis.

Management Response

Management has reviewed the finding and concurs with the recommended corrective action. The action has been entered into our GRC system, and automated reminders have been assigned to the owner.

Owner: Director of Corporate Development • Due: 2012-07-28
PMR-2856-006INFORMATIONALREMEDIATED
Observation

UK Gender Pay Gap report for 2012 uses incorrect methodology for calculating quartiles

Corrective Action Required

Update the 401(k) plan's investment policy statement (IPS) to reflect current fiduciary best practices and document the committee's review of investment performance against the IPS on a quarterly basis.

Management Response

Management disputes the risk classification of this finding. While acknowledging the documentation gap, Lockwood Ferris LLP believes the underlying practices are compliant with applicable requirements. A formal response memorandum has been filed with the engagement team under separate cover.

Owner: Senior Manager of Strategic Initiatives • Due: 2012-08-28
